CheckTitle: Default global session access does not allow password-only sign-in
Description: Broad active rules in the default Okta sign-on or global session policy are evaluated so access requires MFA or is denied.
Risk: Password-only global session access allows stolen or reused passwords to establish Okta sessions without a second authentication factor.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Global Session Policy or Security > Okta Sign-on Policy.
2. Open the broad/default policy that applies to general users.
3. Edit the active default or catch-all rule.
4. Set access to require a factor in addition to password/IdP, or deny access where appropriate.
5. Save and test sign-in for a pilot group before broad rollout.

Recommendation.Text: Update broad global session policy rules so default access requires MFA or denies access instead of allowing password-only sign-in.

Notes: Requires okta.policies.read. Classic Engine calls this Okta sign-on policy; Identity Engine calls it global session policy.
